findNextClaimable() - Method in interface com.endpointposture.job.PostureJobRepository
Finds and locks the single highest-priority, oldest, currently- eligible QUEUED job - FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED is what makes this safe under concurrency (see JobService.claimNextJob() for why this must be called inside a @Transactional method).
